_doc: T032 LEGAL gov-oracle (TT-478 / TT-717). Ireland Capital Acquisitions Tax charge (CATCA 2003), beneficiary-side. Each case asserts the Catala-computed CAT equals the AUTHORITATIVE figure live-sourced from revenue.ie on `sourced_at` — never from memory (HALT fork 2). scripts/oracle_verify.py runs CatInheritanceCharge.Charge with `inputs` and requires the Computed-arm money to equal `expected_money` (EUR). Group classification from kinship is out-of-scope for the rule (supplied by the caller); each case fixes `cat_group` directly. NeedsHuman cases (relief_claimed) are covered by the standard's own *.test-fixtures.json, not here (the scalar harness asserts the Computed arm).
statute: Capital Acquisitions Tax Consolidation Act 2003 (CATCA 2003): Sch 2 (group thresholds + aggregation since 5 December 1991); rate 33%; s.70/s.71 (spouse/civil-partner exemption)

cases.label: groupA-above-threshold-500k
cases.citation_quote: If Eric has used up his entire available threshold, the tax on €100,000 at 33% is €33,000.
cases.note: Group A threshold €400,000 (revenue.ie cat-thresholds.aspx, on/after 2 Oct 2024); rate 33% (cat-rates.aspx). Taxable excess €500,000 − €400,000 = €100,000 × 33% = €33,000 (the verbatim revenue.ie worked-example figure).

cases.label: groupB-inside-threshold-30k
cases.citation_quote: You only pay tax on the value of a gift or inheritance above the tax-free group threshold amount.
cases.note: Group B threshold €40,000; benefit €30,000 is below threshold → taxable excess €0 → CAT €0 (Computed €0, distinct from the spouse exemption).

cases.label: groupB-aggregation-14k-excess
cases.citation_quote: Value of property €20,000; Value of prior benefits in Group B €34,000; Less Group B threshold €40,000; Taxable excess €14,000; Tax due @ 33% €4,620.
cases.note: revenue.ie Example 4 (1 March 2025): available threshold €40,000 − €34,000 prior = €6,000; taxable excess €20,000 − €6,000 = €14,000; × 33% = €4,620 (verbatim revenue.ie table, re-confirmed live 2026-07-02). Exercises CATCA 2003 Sch 2 para 3 aggregation.

cases.label: groupC-above-threshold-50k
cases.citation_quote: On or after 2 October 2024 | Group A €400,000 | Group B €40,000 | Group C €20,000

cases.label: spouse-exempt
cases.citation_quote: Gifts and inheritances taken by a spouse or civil partner are exempt from CAT.
cases.note: CATCA 2003 s.70/s.71 — spouse/civil-partner transfers fully exempt; the exemption takes precedence (Computed €0 regardless of value).
